svg.title: Test point size, spacing and keep-outs
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of the corner of a board with the bottom edge of the board along the bottom. Three round test points TP1 to TP3 sit in a row, each a copper pad 1.0 mm in diameter (0.9 mm minimum) with the solder mask cleared round it, 2.54 mm apart center to center (1.9 mm minimum), each fed by a trace under the mask. An 0603 resistor sits 1 mm from TP1, the minimum gap to a short part. A fourth test point, TP4, is kept 5 mm from a tall radial capacitor 8 mm in diameter; a probe can't reach the shaded 5 mm zone around it. The strip along the board edge that conveyors and fixtures grip is marked at 3 mm (minimum) and 5 mm (recommended); no test point is inside it.

g.text: Test point 1.0 mm in diameter, 2.54 mm apart
At least 0.9 mm in diameter and 1.9 mm apart
Short part: at least 1 mm away
Tall part: probes can't reach this zone
5 mm from parts taller than 5.7 mm (IPC-2221C)
Edge strip held by conveyors and fixtures
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
All test points on one side of the board.
Test points: mask cleared, no paste, name in silkscreen.
